learning_outcomes.text: The course provides an introduction to object-oriented programming, using the Java language to illustrate fundamental concepts such as objects, methods, classes, interfaces, inheritance, polymorphism, generic types, packages, iterators, and exceptions. Particular emphasis is placed on the use and design of software libraries and on general aspects such as modularity, robustness, reusability, and maintainability of code, illustrating concepts such as abstraction, encapsulation, information hiding, generalization, and specialization that allow for the creation of complex large-scale applications.
Knowledge and understanding of the main standards of object-oriented design.
Knowledge and understanding of techniques for large-scale object-oriented programming.
Knowledge and understanding of the UML software design language.
Knowledge and understanding of the JAVA programming language.
Ability to design an application consisting of different classes and associations, and different, also concurrent, activities that operate on them.
Ability to evaluate the quality of an application, distinguishing aspects related to data modeling from those related to process modeling.

Through design activities and course exercises, the student will be able to communicate/share the requirements of a medium-complexity software application, as well as the design choices and methodologies for designing and developing such an application.

In addition to the classic learning abilities provided by the theoretical study of didactic material, the course delivery methods, particularly the design activities, stimulate the student to independently deepen certain topics presented in the course, work in groups, and concretely apply the notions and techniques learned during the course.
Development according to the UML methodology.

syllabus_topics: UML class diagram and its implementation
UML state and transition diagram and its implementation
UML activity diagram and its implementation
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
